title: JobMatch — Agents & LLM
description: LangGraph agents, FastAPI and llama.cpp (Qwen) observability for jobmatch-agent.

panels.title: Analyses completed
panels.description: Analyses that finished with status `completed` over the selected time range (increase of jobmatch_analyses_total).

panels.title: Analyses rejected
panels.description: Analyses that finished with status `rejected` over the selected time range (increase of jobmatch_analyses_total).

panels.title: Analyses failed
panels.description: Analyses that finished with status `failed` over the selected time range (increase of jobmatch_analyses_total).

panels.title: Analyses in progress
panels.description: Analyses currently running in the API (gauge, latest value).

panels.title: Median match score
panels.description: Median (p50) of the CV/offer match score (0-100) over the selected range, estimated from the jobmatch_match_score histogram. Red < 50, orange < 70, green >= 70.

panels.title: API error rate (5xx)
panels.description: Share of API requests answered with a 5xx status over the selected range. Green < 1 %, orange < 5 %, red >= 5 %.

panels.title: Node duration p50 / p95
panels.description: Latency of each LangGraph node (supervisor, parse_offer, parse_cv, score_match, verify_skills, analyze_gaps, write_letter, review_letter, verify_claims, human_review), from the jobmatch_agent_node_duration_seconds histogram. Solid = p95, dashed = p50.

panels.title: Node errors by node
panels.description: Failures raised inside graph nodes (jobmatch_agent_node_errors_total), per minute.

panels.title: LLM tokens / min by node and kind
panels.description: Tokens consumed per minute by each node, split into prompt (input) and completion (output) tokens (jobmatch_llm_tokens_total, from the LLM usage metadata).

panels.title: Review iterations distribution
panels.description: Number of writer/reviewer loops per analysis over the selected range (jobmatch_review_iterations histogram, per bucket upper bound).

panels.title: Match score distribution
panels.description: Distribution of match scores (0-100) over the selected range (jobmatch_match_score histogram, per bucket upper bound).

panels.title: Requests / s by route and status
panels.description: HTTP request rate of the FastAPI app (jobmatch_http_requests_total). 5xx series in red, 4xx in orange.

panels.title: Latency p95 by route
panels.description: 95th percentile HTTP latency per route (jobmatch_http_request_duration_seconds).

panels.title: jobmatch-api scrape
panels.description: Prometheus `up` for the jobmatch-api target (api:8000/metrics).

panels.title: llama-server scrape
panels.description: Prometheus `up` for the llama-server target (host 172.17.0.1:8080/metrics).

panels.title: Generation tokens / s
panels.description: Throughput: completion tokens generated per second across all slots (rate of llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total). Server-reported: average decode speed of recent requests (llamacpp:predicted_tokens_seconds).

panels.title: Prompt tokens / s
panels.description: Prompt processing (prefill) throughput (rate of llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total) and the server-reported average prefill speed (llamacpp:prompt_tokens_seconds). Cached prompt tokens (llamacpp:prompt_tokens_cached_total) shown separately.

panels.title: Requests processing / deferred
panels.description: Requests currently being processed by llama-server slots (2 slots configured) and requests queued waiting for a free slot.

panels.title: Slot utilisation & prompt cache reuse
panels.description: This llama-server build does not expose a KV-cache usage metric (llamacpp:kv_cache_usage_ratio is absent from /metrics). As a proxy, this shows the average number of busy slots per decode step (llamacpp:n_busy_slots_per_decode, max = 2 slots) and the prompt cache reuse ratio (cached / (cached + processed) prompt tokens).

panels.title: Decision model vs LLM agreement
panels.description: Share of questions where the decision model (jevos, calibrated) and the LLM gave the same verdict over the selected range, per task. skill_evidence: LLM credit >= 0.5 vs P(evidence) >= 0.5 (verify_skills). claim_supported: reviewer flagged the claim and P(supported) < 0.5 (verify_claims).

panels.title: Reviewer claims dismissed
panels.description: Reviewer 'unsupported claim' issues dismissed by verify_claims (calibrated P(supported) >= 0.8) over the selected range: reviewer false positives caught by the decision model.

panels.title: Decisions / min by task and outcome
panels.description: jobmatch_decisions_total: yes / no answers of the decision model, plus error (backend unreachable -> LLM-only fallback) and skipped (CV too long for jevos' 8192-token context).

panels.title: Decision latency p50 / p95 by task
panels.description: Duration of one decision-model call (jobmatch_decision_duration_seconds), as seen by the api. Solid = p95, dashed = p50.
